source: Can you make a 3d Parkour game where you keep doing colourful parkour higher and higher and if you fall just try again from the place you landed on also make it get harder the further up you get and make it so the parkour never ends and make it have like wallhops, dissapearing staircase when you walk on it, kill bricks and all sorts

image_prompt.text: A chain of brightly coloured platforms stacking upward, spaced to the physics limits, forming the ordered route through the climb
Staircases and platforms that vanish shortly after being stepped on
Wall sections set up for wallhops, plus trusses and scrambles that gain height
Kill bricks placed along the route that kill on contact
Every platform doubles as a safe landing pad, so a fall restarts from the last place the player landed rather than the bottom
An end reward area at the top of the climb

layout_placement.text: A respawn point registered on each platform the player successfully lands on
The payoff area at the end of the course

notes: Obby rather than Infinite Runner: forward motion is the player - they take discrete jumps at their own pace - even though the course never ends.
Wallhops are a glitch-obby technique that relies on undocumented Humanoid state-machine timing. The P6 generator cannot validate that spacing, so those sections have to be treated as author-supplied.
winner-zone comes from the preset and fights the prompt: the user says the parkour never ends, so there is no top to reward.
An endless tower cannot be framed in one top-down image. It has to be decomposed into a repeating generated segment, with difficulty parameters rising per segment.

open_questions.ask: How tall is one generated segment before it repeats? An endless tower has to be built as a repeating chunk rather than one map.
If the climb never ends, is there anything to chase - a height record, a leaderboard - or is the height itself the whole game?

theme: Stylized / Toon - bright saturated colour-coded blocks against open sky

coverage_missing.ask: How tall is one segment before the generation repeats?
Is there a height record or leaderboard to chase, or is climbing the whole game?
Colourful is clear, but should the blocks be plain neon primitives or dressed as something?

answers.ask: How tall is one generated segment before it repeats? An endless tower has to be built as a repeating chunk rather than one map.
answers.answer: Use small repeating vertical segments, about 100 studs tall each, so the tower can keep generating above the player without needing a huge map.

answers.ask: If the climb never ends, is there anything to chase - a height record, a leaderboard - or is the height itself the whole game?
answers.answer: Add a height record and a simple leaderboard; the goal is to climb as high as possible.
